items.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe and I’ve already had a fun conversation with Jane Bunnett...

ctx.x: Jane was interviewed via Zoom on January 25, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’ve already had a fun conversation with Jane Bunnett, but we’ll keep going.
